subject: general
question: Kudremukh mines are located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Karnataka.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kudremukh mines:-**

 
 
• **These are located in Karnataka.**
 
• It is a small mining town located in the Western Ghats of Karnataka.
 
• It is known for its iron ore mines and Kudremukh National Park.
